bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; test -f deploy/compose.videobot.telegram.yaml || { echo VIDEOBOT_COMPOSE_MISSING; exit 75; }; command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo DOCKER_MISSING; exit 81; }; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo DOCKER_ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE; exit 82; }; if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Eiq 'create.?videobot|videobot'; then echo VIDEOBOT_CONTAINER_PRESENT; exit 83; fi; echo VIDEOBOT_COMPOSE_PRESENT_NO_ACTIVE_NAMED_CONTAINER
